title: Operator browser login and the chg dashboard

story.i_want_to: open one page that answers the chg audit questions
story.so_that: the 2026-10-28 audit takes a page load instead of ssh into four machines

rationale: loopctl#1014 'Done when': the audit questions are answered from one page.

acceptance_criteria.description: An operator logs in from a browser with a WebAuthn assertion against the tenant's enrolled authenticator; the session lasts at most 12 hours, is signed and HttpOnly, and lands in a new :operator live_session whose on_mount refuses an unauthenticated socket.

/chg shows, filterable by repo, host and period: gate outcomes over time (pass, fail, error, skipped) and the fallback rate (mode all with its reason); selection quality (selected against the floor, missed tests); time per gate phase (hydrate_ms, static_ms, affected_ms, tests_ms, and lock wait when rows carry it).

/chg also shows flaky tests (rows of kind flaky with their quarantine or issue reference), review outcomes per merged PR with findings by severity and disposition and merged_without_counted_round flagged (US-50.4), runner samples (kind runner), and changes flagged gap or stale (US-50.2) with their cursor.
Aggregations run on HeavyReadRepo through Loopctl.HeavyRead, scoped by tenant, and each panel renders an empty state rather than an error when no rows exist.
The page follows docs/design-system.md (dark, slate, Geist Mono for ids, hosts and shas) and is checked at desktop and phone width before review.

test_cases.name: panels render from seeded rows
preconditions: seeded gate, chg, flaky, runner rows and one outcome
expected_results: each panel has its element id and counts matching the seed

technical_notes: WebAuthn assertion code exists for custody claims; the thread-page browser login deleted with Epic 45 (#984, introduced in 32abe613) is the prior shape to restore, not to re-invent.
Use streams for long lists; no LiveComponents.
